name: Atexxo Zone 1 iPhone 15
summary: The Atexxo Zone 1 iPhone 15 is a standard Apple iPhone 15 converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It uses a flameproof (Ex db) housing. The phone runs iOS 27.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex tb IIIC T135°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex db IIC T4 Gb / Ex tb IIIC T135°C Db

safety.conditions: Flameproof Ex db enclosure (dust: Ex tb). Specific conditions (IECEx EPS 24.0072X): Ta −20 to +50 °C; no repair of flameproof joints; screws min. property class A4-70; original parts only; protect glass windows from impact > 2 J; do not open in hazardous location; battery charging only outside hazardous location; SIM can be fitted by the user in a safe area; EX-ATEXXO-STRAP accessory original part only.

unconfirmed.os.securityUntil: Apple doesn't publish an end date; its legal minimum is five years from first sale. Previous iPhone models have had security updates for seven years or more.
unconfirmed.specs.wirelessCharging: As listed on Apple's tech specs, which don't mention Qi2.
unconfirmed.specs.weightG: Atexxo gives 525 g in its flyer and 528 g in a product listing.

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Security updates for 7+ years (based on previous model support)
A standard Apple iPhone 15 inside, with the same apps and Apple device management as other iPhones
limitations: T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Satellite SOS not confirmed to work through the enclosure
